title: The AI's 'no visit in 10 days' counts a member who renewed today after a long break, and its See all opens a list with a different rule
what: When the owner asks the AI who has not come for N days, or taps the 'Not seen for 10+ days' idea, a member who came back today after two months off is counted as 'no visit in 60 days', because the count starts from the last visit before the break, not from the new plan. The See all link then opens Losing the habit, which leaves that member out (and also leaves out anyone whose plan ends within 7 days, whom the AI count keeps). The owner sees one number on the AI card and a different list one tap later, and may send 'we miss you' to someone who paid today.
expected: A member's days away count from the later of their last visit and the start of their current plan run, and the AI count and the list behind See all use the same rule or say plainly that they differ.
how_often: whenever a member comes back after a break of more than 10 days
fix_line: Count days away from the start of the current plan run when that is later than the last visit, and make See all show the same group

title: A personal training pack changes the member's plan end on the phone but not in the admin app
what: The admin app never lets a personal training pack decide when a member's gym plan ends. The member's phone does: it takes whichever plan covering today ends last, and any plan starting later, personal training packs included. So a member whose gym plan ends on 30 Nov but who has a training pack to 31 Dec sees 'ends 31 Dec' on the phone and gets no plan-ending reminder, while the admin app shows 'Ending in 1-3 days'. A training pack bought to start next week also counts on the phone as a renewal already paid, so every plan-ending reminder is skipped.
expected: The phone's plan end and its plan-ending reminders read only gym plans, as the admin app does, so both show the same end date.
who: members with a personal training pack, and their gym
how_often: every member who has a training pack that ends after, or starts after, their gym plan
fix_line: Leave personal training packs out when the server picks the member's current and next plan

title: A renewal paid to start a few days after the old plan ends still shows the member as ending
what: If the desk sells a renewal that starts two or more days after the old plan's last day (a member going away for a week), the admin app still counts that member under 'Ending today' or 'Ending in 1-3 days', in 'Plans ending within 7 days' for messages and in the AI's plans-ending list, so the owner chases someone who has already paid. The member's phone treats the same renewal as paid and sends no reminder, so the two disagree.
expected: A member with a paid plan starting later is not counted as ending; the tile and the message group leave them out or mark them as renewed, as the phone does.
how_often: each renewal sold with a gap of two days or more
fix_line: Leave members with a paid later plan out of the ending counts, or show them as renewed

evidence: data:Crispy Curves has 3 members, 2 plans, 2 members with visits, so a recount proves nothing; the ugly data pack is not among the inputs, compared by code only
